bodies.name: Assemblée nationale (French National Assembly)
bodies.layout: The homepage opens with a dark utility bar (language switcher, search, account login) above a mega-menu menu bar covering 'Vos députés', 'Travaux parlementaires', 'Connaître l'Assemblée' and 'Découvrir les lieux'. Below that sits a rotating news carousel of committee hearings and plenary session updates, dated and tagged by category (Commissions, Séance publique, Présidence). A large embedded video/livestream module ('L'Assemblée en vidéo') follows, then a two-column block pairing 'La Présidence' with an interactive députés search map of France. Further down are dense grids of legislative-document shortcuts (textes adoptés, rapports, pétitions) and a dark-red-accented footer with legal mentions, RSS feeds and cookie management links.
ui_patterns: Mega-dropdown menu with icon-labeled top-level categories
Dated news/agenda cards tagged by parliamentary body (Commissions, Séance publique)
Embedded live video/hemicycle streaming module
Interactive clickable SVG maps for finding elected representatives by region
Dense sitemap-style footer with legal/accessibility/RSS/cookie links
Newsletter subscription block with GDPR data-usage notice
Legislature-numbered URL routing (e.g. /dyn/17/...) reflecting the current session
Utility bar for account login/registration separate from main nav

bodies.name: Gouvernement français / info.gouv.fr — Site officiel du Gouvernement (French Government official site)
bodies.layout: Note: exact CSS could not be retrieved (site returns 403 to non-browser requests), so layout is based on the rendered page content and known DSFR conventions. The homepage (gouvernement.fr redirects to info.gouv.fr) opens with a slim header bar offering 'Espace presse' and a display-theme toggle (light/dark/system), sitting above a search overlay and simple top menu. A large 'À la Une' (Headlines) section presents 5-6 news story cards in a grid with photo, category tag, and headline. This is followed by a horizontal-scrolling video reel ('À regarder'), a themed campaign banner (e.g. anti-narcotrafic campaign) with its own sub-cards, an editorial picks section ('Le choix de la rédaction'), and a 'Grands dossiers' section presenting major cross-government policy programs as large image tiles. The footer closes with a two-column 'Gouvernement et institutions' block linking to the Prime Minister's office and government composition pages.
ui_patterns: Light/dark/system theme picker exposed directly in the header
Full-page search overlay triggered from a magnifying-glass icon
News headline grid ('À la Une') mixing photo cards and category tags
Government dossier/campaign banners promoting flagship policy initiatives
Newsletter opt-in modules embedded mid-page ('Point Gouv.')
Browser push-notification opt-in prompt for site updates
DSFR-style Marianne-crest usage implied via 'République Française' masthead branding
Institutional footer segmented into 'Le Premier ministre' and 'À propos du Gouvernement' link columns

bodies.name: Police nationale — Ministère de l'Intérieur (French National Police)
bodies.layout: Note: raw CSS was blocked (Cloudflare returns 403 to non-browser clients), so styling detail is estimated from confirmed DSFR class names seen in the rendered HTML (e.g. image style path 'styles/dsfr_16_9') plus known DSFR tokens. The homepage is built on Drupal 11 with the DSFR template: a top identity bar reads 'Ministère de l'Intérieur — Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité' linking back to the homepage, above a search toggle and a 'police.tv' utility link. A three-item primary nav ('Vos démarches', 'Nous découvrir', 'Vous informer', 'Nous rejoindre') expands into dropdown submenus. The hero section shows the Police nationale crest/logo, a bold H1 welcome headline, and three CTA buttons (online procedures, cadet recruitment, join the force). Below that is a vertical feed of dated news/dossier cards (recruitment campaigns, the G7 Évian summit security operation, in-memoriam tributes) each with a 16:9 photo, topical tags, and publication date. The footer lists social-media icons, cross-links to sibling gouv.fr sites (legifrance, data.gouv.fr, service-public.gouv.fr), and standard legal/accessibility/cookie links plus an Etalab open-licence notice.
ui_patterns: DSFR identity bar with 'Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité' motto linking to home
Dropdown mega-nav split into démarches / découvrir / informer / rejoindre sections
Prominent recruitment CTA buttons ('Rejoindre la police nationale') on the hero
Dated news/dossier cards tagged with topic keywords (recrutement, hommage, sécurité publique)
16:9 DSFR-standard image aspect ratio class (dsfr_16_9) applied to all content thumbnails
Cross-institutional footer linking to sibling gouv.fr portals (legifrance, data.gouv.fr)
Light/dark/system display-theme toggle in header
Etalab open-licence (etalab-2.0) attribution notice in footer
